## Verification
- [ ] Offline tests and source audit pass; regression test added for behavior changes.
- [ ] Packaging verifier and its negative tests pass if packaging changed.
- [ ] No credentials, personalized URLs, caches, account identifiers, DRM data or raw captures.
- [ ] Native playback, uncapped quality and subscription/DRM boundaries preserved.
- [ ] Documentation/changelog updated as needed.

State exact commands/results and any pending playback, HDR, AirPlay or audio-device checks. Do not describe offline tests as live playback verification. Still capture must remain capability-gated; no protected-media bypass, recording or video export.
